Kegon Falls.do: 09:20-10:20: one hour, one lift car, 35 people. Split at the coach - half down the Kegon Falls Elevator (100 m of bedrock, a one-minute ride, then about 70 wet steps out; ¥600 adult, ¥550 at 30 OR MORE, no booking, first come), half on the FREE prefectural rim deck two minutes behind car park No.1, then swap about 10:00. Lift 07:30-18:00, no closing day. Coach park ¥2,190 a use. The Akechidaira Ropeway is SHUT for renewal until 「2027年9月」 - say so before anyone asks for the panorama.
Kegon Falls.eat: Almost nothing is open at 09:20. Juichiya does yuba yakisoba at ¥500 from 08:00, and the Chuzenji Kanko Center counters open 09:00 and are the first kitchens available - himemasu, landlocked sockeye out of the lake below you, salt-grilled or fried. The hand-cut soba houses do not lift their shutters until 11:00, and lunch is already booked for 12:30 down in Nikko, so treat anything up here as a shared taste rather than a meal.
Kegon Falls.snack: The real window is 10:12-10:20 on the walk back to the coach, and there are exactly two things trading: Juichiya's ¥500 yuba yakisoba (from 08:00) or a yuba counter at the Chuzenji Kanko Center (from 09:00), both on the lakefront parade three to four minutes from the coach. Nothing is sold at the lift door or on the basin deck, and spray carries 150 m onto that deck, so nothing survives being carried down. Eat standing on the parade.
Kegon Falls.buy: Rakusan Koji Kojimaya on the lakefront parade, 09:00-20:00 and the latest-opening shop on the lake: its own cave-aged 「楽山湖」 wine, matured five years under Mt Nantai, at ¥1,500 the half bottle and ¥2,500 the full, plus Nikko Gokenin sake at ¥2,250 for 1.8 L. Glass and well over 100 ml, so CHECKED baggage only - and 1.8 L is 2 kg of a 25 kg allowance. Buy on the way out at about 10:10, never before the lift.
Kegon Falls.see: The 97 m single drop, only about 7 m wide at normal flow, head-on from basin level with the Junitaki side-seeps trickling out of the cliff beside it; on a windy morning the spray carries roughly 150 m to the deck and throws rainbows. Take the LOWEST of the three stepped decks and the far right-hand end of the rail - the top deck's tunnel mouth eats the sky. At 09:20 the sun is SE at 45°, behind you: the only hour of the day that is true. Wipe the lens between frames.
correctedFromSeed: Added what the seed omits from day5-nikko essentials: the group rate is 30 OR MORE (not 35) and the coach pays about ¥2,190 for prefectural car park No.1 at 日光市中宮祠2480, roughly 07:00-22:00 April-November.

The seed's Miyamado 'Kekko manju, ¥1,500 for ten' has no record in any batch, so it is not repeated - Juichiya and Rakusan Koji Kojimaya are the only two lakefront shops we hold, and both carry seed-level confidence only (neither publishes a reachable page).
The seed's ¥650 Nikko yuba and ¥680 tamari-pickle prices at the Chuzenji Kanko Center are not in any batch record, so the counters are carried with their 09:00 opening but without the prices.

The 07:30-18:00 lift window is held as the project's own correction against Tochigi Prefecture's own tourism site, Jalan and Guidoor, which all still print 08:00-17:00 for 1 Mar-30 Nov; kegon.jp is robots-blocked to us, so this is not re-read at source.

Nikko Toshogu Shrine.do: SATURDAY CHANGES THE START. The shrine's own access page prints 「土・日・祝祭日、特別な行事のある日は駐車不可」, so on 12 September the coach cannot use the shrine lot: set down at 市営西参道第2・3駐車場 (安川町2-47, 140 spaces, 24 h, about ¥1,540 a large bus) and walk 10 minutes up the Nishi-sando. Of 11:00-12:15 that leaves about 50 minutes of looking: Sanzaru on the way IN, Yomeimon, Nemuri-neko, Honjido Naki-ryu. Drop the 207 steps to the Okumiya.
Nikko Toshogu Shrine.eat: Nikko yuba, spelled 湯波 here - thicker and rolled, not Kyoto's 湯葉. Ganso Ebisuya does courses ¥2,400-5,000 and Yugen sets ¥1,590-2,130, but both are 1.3-1.6 km downhill near Shinkyo, a 35-40 minute round trip out of a 75-minute slot, and lunch is already a 12:30 ramen-and-gyoza set. Seek the yuba out; do not plan the meal round it. Nikko Coffee Nishi-sando (安川町10-20) is 4 minutes from the coach lot, 10:00-17:00, closed FRIDAYS, so Saturday it is open.
Nikko Toshogu Shrine.snack: Honestly thin, and the Saturday walk-up is why. We hold no record of a stall inside the precinct, and the seed's ¥300 deep-fried yuba manju at Sakaeya sits outside Tobu Nikko Station, 1.3 km below Shinkyo and far outside this window. What IS four minutes from the Nishi-sando lot is Nikko Coffee (10:00-17:00, closed Fridays, open Sat 12 Sep) for natural-ice kakigori - take it at about 12:05 on the way back, not on the way up.
Nikko Toshogu Shrine.buy: Goshuin at ¥500, and they are all PRE-WRITTEN slips - no on-the-spot brushwork, so the wait is usually under ten minutes even at Saturday midday, which is the only reason they fit. Two different stamps: the office just inside the Yomeimon, and the Yakushido exit for the Naki-ryu. Paper, weightless, indestructible - the best value of the day. Do NOT buy the Treasure House: ¥1,000 extra on top of the ¥1,600 (¥2,400 combined, ¥2,240 at 35+) and 40 minutes indoors is half the visit.
Nikko Toshogu Shrine.see: The Yomeimon at close range - some 500 carvings of Chinese sages, dragons and children across 11 m of gate, the gold leaf and vermilion at their brightest for a generation since the Heisei restoration finished in March 2017. Stand on the forecourt 8-10 m south, slightly left of the centre line, and fill the frame with the upper two tiers. At 11:00 the sun is SSE at 56° and the eaves throw the carving into hard shade: expose for the shaded lacquer. Sanzaru is one scene of an eight-panel frieze.
correctedFromSeed: The seed's summary treats 11:00-12:15 as 75 minutes on site. It is not: the Saturday coach ban means a 10-minute walk each way from the Nishi-sando municipal lot, leaving about 50 minutes of looking after 15 minutes of internal walking (day5-nikko d5t01nishisando, essentials.transport, subRoute d5sr02toshogu).

Kanaya Hotel Bakery Shinkyo branch is 10:00-17:00, not the seed's 08:00-18:00, and it sells out by mid-afternoon; it is also 1 km below the Omotemon, so it is a coach stop at Shinkyo rather than a walk out of the slot (day5-nikko shopping d1e348592e90, two independent listings).

The seed leaves 'drop either the 207 steps or the Naki-ryu' open. Resolved: drop the Okumiya. The Naki-ryu is explicitly inside the ¥1,600 ticket (本地堂（鳴龍） is listed in the inclusions) and is unrepeatable; the Okumiya is 207 steps for a view.
Added from essentials that the Treasure House is NOT in the main ticket: ¥1,000 adult / ¥400 child extra, which the seed's mustBuy does not mention while recommending the visit's other purchases.

The seed's Ebisuya/Yugen coordinate sits inside the precinct, which is wrong - both restaurants are on the Kamihatsuishi/Shinkyo stretch 1.3-1.6 km downhill; flagged in day5-nikko place 8effb3a92604 and reflected in the eat line's round-trip cost.

Edo Wonderland Nikko Edomura.do: REVISED 4 Sep: this is a TWO-hour stop and the coach leaves at 16:00, not 2 h 30 to 16:30. At the Sekisho ask for the 団体 AFTERNOON 通行手形 - ¥4,400 adult against ¥5,800 at the individual day window, and 14:00 is exactly when the afternoon tariff opens - and take the printed 演目スケジュール sheet, because nothing inside is walk-up except the two ninja mazes. Two hours buys ONE theatre, the ~15:00 procession, one ninja walk-through and the shop. Groups of 20+ must pre-book the coach park.
Edo Wonderland Nikko Edomura.eat: Named counters on the street: Nihon-soba Yabu ¥900-1,700 (sit-down, and choosing it costs you the theatre), Sumibiyaki Yamakujira ¥500-1,400 for charcoal skewers, Kamado-ya ¥300-1,400 for dango and donburi, Shinanoya for amazake and warabimochi, Kyuyama for nikuman and kakigori. Lunch was at 12:30, so nobody needs a meal here. Brief the group BEFORE the gate, not at the table: these are Edo-period counters with no halal certification and sake on the menu.
Edo Wonderland Nikko Edomura.snack: Kamado-ya's skewered dango, ¥300-1,400, cash at the counter with no seat to fight for - or a nikuman at Kyuyama. Timing matters now: with the coach at 16:00 the sub-route's 16:10 dango step and 16:20 souvenir step BOTH fall after departure, so do them by about 15:45 - dango in the hand walking back, boxes at the Sekisho end on the way out. 49.5 ha of gravel at 29°C with almost no shade on the main street, so water in hand throughout.
Edo Wonderland Nikko Edomura.buy: Echigoya's 「袖の下」 (the bribe) manju box, ¥1,450 for nine, with golden koban wafers hidden UNDER the buns so you hand it over reciting the kabuki line - the best office gift of the trip because the gag travels. Nyanmage, the topknotted samurai-cat mascot, is the volume buy: steamed kintsuba ¥750 for nine, choco crunch ¥650 for ten, small plush from ¥1,500. Buy at 15:45 on the way OUT; boxes carried round a gravel park for two hours arrive crushed. Manju is a two-week product.
Edo Wonderland Nikko Edomura.see: The Oiran-douchuu: high-clogged oiran gliding down the main street with attendants and parasols, five to ten minutes end to end, free with admission and comfortably the best photograph of Day 5. Usually 15:00, but the operator says times move with the date, so read the gate sheet before planning anything round it. Be on the EAST kerb 20 m up-street from Nihonbashi by 14:50 and crouch. Then the Nihonbashi frame: 49.5 ha of real timber Edo, still a working film set, no modern roofline in shot.
correctedFromSeed: The stop is 14:00-16:00 (2 h) with a 16:00 departure - the 4 Sep revision cut 30 minutes. The seed still prints '14:00-16:30, two and a half hours' (day5-nikko itineraryRevisions, ITINERARY_CHANGE.md §2).

The seed's 'two or three shows' is no longer achievable. With a 15-minute Sekisho regroup the usable time falls to about 1 h 45, the ~15:50 last theatre start now begins after the coach leaves, and the realistic maximum is ONE theatre plus the procession.
Added the 団体 afternoon 通行手形 at ¥4,400 (groups from just 8 people; ¥5,800 individual day pass, ¥5,000 individual afternoon) - the seed gives only the costume price and no ticket arithmetic.
The sub-route's own last two steps - Kamado-ya dango at 16:10 and the Nyanmage/Echigoya shop at 16:20 - are both after the revised 16:00 coach, so both were pulled forward to about 15:45.
Added that groups of 20 or more must book the on-site coach park (about ¥1,300) by phone or e-mail in advance, from day5-nikko essentials.transport.

Hotel Nikko Tsukuba.do: REVISED 4 Sep: dinner is 16:45 en route and check-in 18:00, not 17:15 and 18:30 - so the evening is about 120 usable minutes to the 20:00 close, not 85. Announce it on the coach before anyone unpacks: Tonarie Tsukuba Square (Q't, MOG, CREO) is three minutes away and ALL THREE buildings shut at 20:00. Then the 600 m loop out through Chuo Park to the floodlit rocket. Be honest about the building: 24-hour reception, but NO shop, NO bar and NO large communal bath.
Hotel Nikko Tsukuba.eat: Dinner was eaten at 16:45, so this is a second-plate evening. In-house: Hitachi-gyu Sansui (main 2F, 17:30-21:00, L.O. 20:00, closed Tuesdays) and Chinese Tao-Li (annexe 2F, L.O. 19:30, the earliest cut-off in the building). FOR 35 PEOPLE the one that works is Aoyama Garari on Q't 3F - 65 seats, up to 40 on one floor, 11:00-23:00 with food L.O. 22:00, and the '21:00 last order' elsewhere is wrong. ROKU at BiVi is a full buy-out at 35; Ramen Tatsuro has SIXTEEN seats.
Hotel Nikko Tsukuba.snack: Two 24-hour konbini within three minutes, both confirmed: FamilyMart inside Tonarie Q't, and ローソン つくば駅バスターミナル店 on BiVi 2F (吾妻1-8-10, 24時間営業 / 休業日：なし). Before 20:00 the better buy is Ropia and the farm stand on CREO 1F - about ¥1,000 fills a bag with Ibaraki natto and cheap local fruit, which is tonight's supper, not a souvenir, because fresh produce does not fly. Starbucks Tonarie CREO runs 07:00-23:00, the only sit-down open either side of mall hours.
Hotel Nikko Tsukuba.buy: Tsukuba no Yoi Shina, Tsukuba Station B1 (吾妻2-128, 08:00-20:00, 無休): the pick for a flight is the fukure-mikan shichimi blend - Mount Tsukuba's own citrus peel in a chilli mix, about ¥600, light, dry and unavailable in Malaysia. CORRECTION: hoshi-imo and natto sweets are NOT in this shop's range; for those use Ropia on CREO 1F. The Tsukuba ham beside it is the trap: chilled, with three nights and a flight to go. Tsukuba City Bussankan next door has the 46 Tsukuba Collection products.
Hotel Nikko Tsukuba.see: The full-size 50 m H-II rocket in the Tsukuba Expo Center forecourt, 600 m out through Chuo Park - floodlit after dark, unfenced from the public path, no ticket, and the best photograph in walking distance. Stand on the public path along the NORTH edge of the forecourt where the rocket clears the sky with no building behind it, shoot portrait, and brace the phone on the low wall because hard uplight smears every hand-held frame. Do NOT promise JAXA: 28 minutes on foot and it opens 10:00.
correctedFromSeed: Check-in is 18:00 and dinner 16:45 en route (4 Sep revision); the seed prints 18:30 and 17:15 and therefore understates the Tonarie window as 'about 85 minutes' when it is nearer 120 (ITINERARY_CHANGE.md §2, expand-d56 d5w30tsuk01).

Tsukuba no Yoi Shina does NOT stock hoshi-imo or natto sweets - its published range is Hojo rice, fukure-mikan goods, research-institute items and seasonal produce from about 45 makers. The seed sends the group there for hoshi-imo; use Ropia on Tonarie CREO 1F instead (topup-tsukuba-shinjuku correction to id a3f5d387ccd7).

Breakfast in Restaurant Serena opens 06:30 with breakfast LAST ORDER 09:00, not the seed's 09:30, and the room seats 63 - so 35 people are more than half of it and need a pre-set group section (day5-nikko d5h01serena, Okura Nikko's own dining page).

Tsukuba Expo Center admission is ¥600 adult / ¥300 child, not the ¥500 our own earlier forecourt records carried; the rocket itself still needs no ticket, and the museum shut at 17:00 anyway (topup-tsukuba-shinjuku tpts05expshop).

The seed offers Saino on Q't 3F as 'the likeliest halal-friendly option' - its halal status is unverified and must be phoned. The venue that can actually take 35 is Aoyama Garari on Q't 3F, whose 21:00 last order as published elsewhere is wrong (operator prints 11:00-23:00, food L.O. 22:00).

Hitachi Seaside Park.do: 09:30 is the opening bell exactly (09:30-17:00 from 1 Sep to 31 Oct; the closing day is TUESDAY, not Monday, so Sunday 13 Sep is open). Enter at the West / Tsubasa Gate, the park's own named nearest entrance to Miharashi Hill: ¥290 adult for parties of 20+ against ¥450 walk-up, no seasonal surcharge in September, large-bus parking ¥1,800. Then walk - 17 minutes up, 17 back, and that IS the hour. The Seaside Train's ¥600 day pass buys one leg, not a tour: the full loop is 40 minutes.
Hitachi Seaside Park.eat: At 09:30 the only outlet trading is Lakeside Cafe by the West Gate (「9時30分から閉園時間まで」, takeout only, waterside terrace): soft-serve, takoyaki, croquettes, coffee. CORRECTION: the melon and hoshi-imo soft-serve, the Hitachinaka 干し芋タルト and the melon baum are at Kinen no Mori Rest House, eight minutes in, and it does NOT open until 10:00 - an hour into a 60-minute stop. The Glass House is out in the dune area, 15 minutes by train: not reachable and back.
Hitachi Seaside Park.snack: Lakeside Cafe at the gate, from 09:30, takeout only - a soft-serve, takoyaki or croquette in the hand before you start walking, because it is the only thing open and there is nothing at all on the hill. Take water there too: 215 open hectares of Pacific coast with no shade on Miharashi Hill and an onshore wind. The park publishes no prices, so budget rather than quote. Kinen no Mori's hoshi-imo tart is the better snack and only the last 30 minutes of the stop reaches it.
Hitachi Seaside Park.buy: The Lakeside Cafe retail counter is the only shop open at 09:30 - and it trades 物販：平日休業（土日祝日のみ営業）, weekends and holidays ONLY, so Sunday 13 Sep is luck rather than planning and a weekday group would find it shut. Listed stock: Nemophila Blue Tea, the park's own coffee, flower-seed packs, bookmarks, eco-bags, plush keychains - tea, seeds and cloth all fly. Budget about ¥1,000. Note the merchandise is nemophila-branded even though the flower is five months away.
Hitachi Seaside Park.see: GREEN kochia, and that is the park's own official state: 緑葉 8月中旬〜9月下旬 with the colour change only from late September - about 40,000 plants over 2.3 ha, 70 cm tall, with the Pacific filling the frame behind them. THERE IS NO NEMOPHILA: that is mid-April to early May. Stand east of the summit marker so the domes fall away downhill, then walk 30 m down the west path, crouch to knee height and shoot BACK INTO the sun for translucent lime. Nobody in green, olive or khaki.
correctedFromSeed: THE NEMOPHILA ERROR: the seed's mustBuy sells 'green-kochia and nemophila merchandise ... only sold here', inheriting the app's Day 6 line. There is no nemophila on 13 Sep - only nemophila branding. Green kochia at peak is the picture (day6-hitachi mustSee 3a908417ee96, the park's own kochia page).

The seed puts the Ibaraki melon and hoshi-imo soft-serve 'from the West Gate kiosks'. They are at Kinen no Mori Rest House, eight minutes inside, which opens 10:00 - two thirds of the stop it is shut. The 09:30 outlet is Lakeside Cafe (day6-hitachi d6hitachi02, d577f5c4daed).

The seed offers the Glass House as 'the one place to sit with a full Pacific horizon'. True, and not available on this stop: it is in the 砂丘エリア by the 海浜口・風のゲート on the far side, a 15-minute train leg from the West Gate.
Rental cycles are ¥600 for THREE HOURS, ¥800 all day - the seed's '¥600 adult' is the three-hour rate (day6-hitachi essentials, the park's own ticket page).

The seed's 'if two minutes can be spared, the big Ferris wheel' understates it: BLUE EYES is inside the Pleasure Garden, a SEPARATE payment from admission (ride tickets in ¥100 units or a ¥3,600 one-day pass) with an unpredictable queue against a 10:30 coach.
No West Gate hoshi-imo shop exists in our records - the only West Gate retail is Lakeside Cafe's weekend-only counter, so the seed's 'hoshi-imo ... from the West Gate shop' is dropped.

Kawagoe Old Town (Kurazukuri Street).do: One hour, and the city decides where it starts: tour coaches use the NORTH SIDE OF CITY HALL (元町1-3-1) - drop-off and pick-up only, 「駐車場としての利用は、できません」 and 「路上での乗降は、行わないでください」 - about 290 m and 5 minutes from Toki no Kane, 7 from Kashiya Yokocho. Order that works: bell tower first while the group is still together, sweet lane second because that is where people scatter, gift shop last. Motomachi Rest House (free, air-conditioned, toilets, about 100 people) is 6 minutes away. Get-back-by 14:25.
Kawagoe Old Town (Kurazukuri Street).eat: Kasho Umon's imo-koi, eaten hot in the hand at the Toki no Kane shop (幸町15-13, 10:00-18:00, closed only over New Year), about ¥250 - a yam-flour steamed bun round a slice of Kawagoe sweet potato and chestnut-azuki paste, and the most Kawagoe thing you can hold. Unagi is out: Ogakiku (仲町3-22, founded 1807) closes THURSDAYS not Mondays so it IS open and runs 10:40-18:00 L.O. on a Sunday, but 50 seats, about ¥4,000 a head and a famous queue mean 35 people do not walk in inside an hour.
Kawagoe Old Town (Kurazukuri Street).snack: The imo-koi at about ¥250, hot at the counter - the sub-route puts it at 14:14, after the sweet lane - and note the 5-piece service box at ¥1,250 is FROZEN (賞味期限 冷凍90日), so eat it, do not pack it. In Kashiya Yokocho individual penny sweets start about ¥50, so ¥500 buys a bag plus one 95 cm brown-sugar fu-gashi from Matsuriku Seika (元町2-11-6, 10:00-17:00, CLOSED MONDAYS - Sunday is fine). Cash in a reachable pocket for the sweet shops.
Kawagoe Old Town (Kurazukuri Street).buy: Kurazukuri Honpo Ichibangai (幸町2-16, 10:00-18:00, closed TUESDAYS): Fukugura monaka packed with whole azuki and mochi at ¥210 each, ¥1,100 for five, ¥1,460 for six, ¥2,090 for nine, ¥4,400 for twenty - 賞味期限 7 日 at room temperature, so it rides the coach fine but bought on the 13th it expires on the 20th. Then Kameya Toki no Kane branch (幸町7-7, 10:00-17:30, founded 1783) for imo-sen sweet-potato crackers, about ¥600 - dry, flat, the best bulk office gift on the street.
Kawagoe Old Town (Kurazukuri Street).see: Toki no Kane: three tiers, about 16 m, rebuilt in 1894 the year after the 1893 Great Kawagoe Fire, and one of Japan's 100 Soundscapes since 1996. Shoot from the WEST pavement about 25 m south, at the Kanetsuki-dori corner, so the tiers stand clear against sky. The automatic striker sounds 06:00 / 12:00 / 15:00 / 18:00 and the coach leaves at 14:30 - a photograph, not a sound. Then look north up Ichibangai from the 1918 former Eighty-Fifth Bank: at 13:45 the SW sun lights the black plaster.
correctedFromSeed: Koedo Kurari is NOT on the kurazukuri street. It is at 新富町1-10-1 on Crea Mall by Hon-Kawagoe, a 15-minute walk, and the city's own page lists Saitama SAKE tasting from 32 breweries with no mention of COEDO beer - so the seed's 'wash it down at Koedo Kurari with COEDO's Beniaka' is both out of range for a one-hour stop and unconfirmed. Dropped.

Ogakiku closes THURSDAYS, not Mondays. The seed's conclusion (open on 13 Sep) survives for the wrong reason, and 50 seats at about ¥4,000 a head means a 35-person group cannot use it (day6-hitachi f565e4c5eef1, the restaurant's own Gnavi listing).
The fu-gashi is 95 cm, not the seed's 'metre-long': Matsuriku Seika's own listing says 長さ(95センチ)も日本一, and the shop is closed Mondays with a ¥500-2,000 band.
Kasho Umon's boxed imo-koi is FROZEN - 賞味期限 製造日より冷凍90日 - so it is not a suitcase gift; the seed implies it can be taken away. Eat it hot at the counter for about ¥250.
Tamariki Seika's hand-pulled candy (seed mustBuy) has no record in any batch, so it is not repeated; the two verified Kashiya Yokocho buys are the penny sweets and Matsuriku Seika's fu-gashi.
Every Kawagoe coordinate in the seed is about 250-350 m out (notes6.md §4), so the stop is now written from the City Hall coach bay outward with the city's own 5- and 7-minute legs.

Shibuya Scramble Crossing.do: Free, 24/7. One hour buys two crossings plus ONE elevated look, so pick it before you arrive. Cross once carried along by the wave out of the Hachiko Exit, once from the opposite corner facing back, then get above it: at street level it is only a crowd. THE COACH CANNOT WAIT - no coach bay at the crossing, and the nearest documented option is Ebisu Garden Place one station away, so fix the muster point and time before anyone steps off. Sunday 15:30 is the shopping crowd, not the commuter surge.
Shibuya Scramble Crossing.eat: Nothing at the crossing itself - that is the honest answer, and street-eating in the middle of it is both impossible and frowned on. Two minutes away is Tokyu Food Show EDGE in Scramble Square B2 (10:00-21:00) for bento, onigiri and famous-name sweets a group can buy fast; Hikarie's ShinQs food floors and its free 11F Sky Lobby are the air-conditioned place to sit and eat them. Dinner is an unagi grilled-rice set at 17:00, so do not let anyone fill up.
Shibuya Scramble Crossing.snack: No stalls at the junction. Standing food is a two-minute walk into Shibuya Center-gai, which at 15:30 on a Sunday is at its densest - fix a regroup point first - or the B2 hall at Scramble Square, where about ¥1,500 covers a Food Show EDGE basket; that is a planning figure, not a quoted price. The cheapest seated view is the price of a drink at the Starbucks SHIBUYA TSUTAYA 2F window counter, dead in front of the crossing - but it is queued out on a Sunday, so send two people, not thirty-five.
Shibuya Scramble Crossing.buy: Tokyu Food Show EDGE, Scramble Square B2 - NAME CORRECTED, the original Tokyu Food Show is the older station-side hall - is the better bet for edible gifts: baked and dry famous-name sweets travel to Malaysia, fresh cream and chilled cake do not. SHIBUYA109 (道玄坂2-29-1) is ten floors of young women's fashion and cosmetics: a landmark to photograph, not a gift shop. MEGA Don Quijote Shibuya Honten (宇田川町28-6) is 24 hours and tax-free, about 400 m and 5 minutes, not 3 and not 8.
Shibuya Scramble Crossing.see: The stacked screens of the Tsutaya / Q FRONT building are what makes the crossing photograph the way it does in films - stand with your back to Hachiko and shoot into them. For the elevated view use the FREE Shibuya Mark City 2F glass corridor: station hours, no ticket, 「スクランブル交差点を斜め上の低い位置から見ることができます」, and Taro Okamoto's 30 m Myth of Tomorrow mural is on the same wall - so mural and vantage point are ONE stop, not two. Paid straight-down shot: MAG8, ¥1,800 with a drink.
correctedFromSeed: No official source supports the seed's 'Shibuya Scramble Square 2F walkway' as a crossing overlook - it is real, free and a fine east-side regroup, but nothing describes a view of the junction from it. The verified free elevated views are the Shibuya Mark City 2F glass corridor and SHIBU NIWA on Tokyu Plaza Shibuya's 17F (free, 一般の方もご利用を頂けます, but closed in bad weather).

MAG'S PARK is now sold as CROSSING VIEW & ROOFTOP LOUNGE MAG8: 入場料 1人1,800円（1DRINK付）, 10:00-22:00, last entry 21:30, plus ¥1,500 per 150 seconds for the sky camera. ¥63,000 for 35 people, so it is a few volunteers. The ¥300 and ¥600 figures still on travel sites are stale.
The B2 hall at Scramble Square is Tokyu Food Show EDGE, a different hall from the original Tokyu Food Show on the station side; the seed names the wrong one.

Don Quijote Shibuya Honten is MEGA Don Quijote and the walk is about 400 m / 5 minutes up Center-gai with a dogleg onto Inokashira-dori - not the seed's 8 minutes, and not Donki's own optimistic 3 (topup-tsukuba-shinjuku tpsj03megadonki).

Myth of Tomorrow's coordinate was north of the crossing; it is inside Mark City's 2F concourse between the JR Tamagawa-guchi gates and the Keio Inokashira gates - the same walk as the free vantage point.
Sunset: the trip's validated solar record gives 17:48 for 13 Sep, not the seed's 17:54 (notes6.md §5). The 'well before sunset' judgement holds either way.

Shinjuku Granbell Hotel.do: Note this is the KABUKICHO Granbell (歌舞伎町2-14-5), not the Shibuya one: 4 min to Higashi-Shinjuku, 6 to Golden Gai, 15 to JR Shinjuku. Dinner was at 17:00 elsewhere, so this is the trip's one genuinely free city evening, and the best thing in it is free: Toei Oedo Line two stops from Higashi-Shinjuku to Tochomae, about ¥180, for the Tokyo Metropolitan Government's 45F South Observatory at 202 m - 入室料金 無料, 入室可能時間 9時30分〜21時30分, and open on a Sunday (it closes 1st and 3rd Tuesdays).
Shinjuku Granbell Hotel.eat: Shinjuku Kabuki Hall / Kabuki Yokocho, Tokyu Kabukicho Tower 2F, 600 m: TEN areas and about 1,300 seats - eight regional 食祭 plus 韓国食祭 and KABUKI CAFE - kiosk-fixed prices, picture menus, no seating charge, 年中無休, and the tower's own floor guide prints 6:00〜翌5:00, so Sunday runs to 05:00 Monday. It is the only room in Kabukicho that absorbs 35 people unbooked. Ichiran Kabukicho (歌舞伎町1-17-10) is 24 hours but TWENTY-FIVE counter booths and no tables.
Shinjuku Granbell Hotel.snack: Kabuki Hall's kiosks are the standing answer at any hour, and its Kanto, Kyushu-Okinawa and Korean stalls give the widest choice for anyone avoiding pork. Otherwise Torikizoku Shinjuku Kabukicho, 7 minutes, Sunday 13:00-04:00, at ¥390 a plate tax-in - the ¥370 price has been stale since 1 May 2025 - or Don Quijote Kabukicho, 8 minutes and 24 hours. Ichiran's classic bowl goes from about ¥980 to about ¥1,080 inside its own 22:00-06:00 late window, kaedama ¥210 to ¥230.
Shinjuku Granbell Hotel.buy: Don Quijote Shinjuku Kabukicho, 歌舞伎町1-16-5, with 24時間営業 and 定休日なし confirmed on the store's own page, 8 minutes from the door. Tax-free is deducted AT THE TILL until 1 Nov 2026 - ¥5,500 in one transaction plus a passport at the tax-free counter, and there is no refund desk to find at Narita. Matcha KitKat multipacks and Tokyo Banana are stacked near the entrance. In mid-September heat buy the chocolate LAST and put it straight in the room fridge.
Shinjuku Granbell Hotel.see: Their own 13F rooftop bar and terrace, looking down into the Kabukicho neon with the Metropolitan Government twin towers behind - and the reason not to pay for a view tonight. Confirm the detail at the desk, because granbellhotel.jp blocks automated fetching: 62 seats, Sunday 14:00-22:30 rather than the 04:00 close it keeps midweek, ¥500 table charge waived for hotel guests. Free on the street: the 12 m Godzilla Head, whose roar-and-light runs hourly only to 20:00 - leave the hotel by 19:45.
correctedFromSeed: The seed's 'free 10-minute projection-mapping show on the building's face from Citizens' Plaza' has NO record in any of our batches, so it is not repeated. What we can source is the free 45F South Observatory itself - 入室料金 無料, 09:30-21:30, open on a Sunday - from the Bureau of Finance's own page.

Kabuki Hall is TEN areas, not the seed's 'nine regional stalls': eight regional 食祭 plus 韓国食祭 and KABUKI CAFE, about 1,300 seats, 年中無休, with the Sunday envelope settled at 6:00〜翌5:00 on the tower's own floor guide (topup-tsukuba-shinjuku correction to id 5e98a1595579).
Ichiran is the KABUKICHO branch at 歌舞伎町1-17-10, 7 minutes away, not 'on Shinjuku-dori' - and it is 25 counter booths with NO tables, so for 35 people it is a trickle or a queue, never one sitting.

Our own earlier Don Quijote source URL was wrong (donki.com shop_id=195 is a Hokkaido store); the Kabukicho store is shop_id=29 at 歌舞伎町1-16-5, and the 8-minute walk in the seed is right against a Trip-1 map claiming 6.
Torikizoku's flat plate price is ¥390 tax-in, not ¥370 (replaced 1 May 2025), and for 35 people there is no 貸切 and no net booking since 2022 - phone ahead or split across branches.

The 13F rooftop bar's Sunday hours, 62 seats and waived table charge remain UNVERIFIED because granbellhotel.jp refuses automated fetching, so they are flagged for the desk rather than promised - the seed states them as fact.

Tokyo Tower.do: Main Deck only. Have the guide holding pre-issued group tickets at the Foot Town 1F lifts for the 09:00 opening and the whole party is on the deck by 09:08. THE RATE QUESTION IS RESOLVED IN THE AGENT'S FAVOUR - ¥1,080 is the travel-agency advance-reservation rate, ¥1,350 the walk-up group discount, ¥9,450 of difference for 35 people - and group settlement is CASH ONLY. Then glass floor and the 360° circuit on 1F, Tower Daijingu and the shop on 2F, out by 10:20. The Top Deck Tour does not fit.
Tokyo Tower.eat: The Foot Town food offer is effectively shut for this whole visit: Mos Burger and its Tokyo Tower Burger open 11:00, Siddique Palace (2F, halal Pakistani) 11:00-21:30, RED° TOKYO TOWER 10:00. Cafe La Tour on Main Deck 1F opens 09:30, not 09:00, so send anyone wanting the Premium Tower Soft - soft serve with a Noppon Brothers monaka wafer - up at 09:30, not 09:05. What IS open at 09:00 is Marion Crepes on Foot Town 1F, whose soft serve is 「牧場直送のハラール認証ソフトクリーム」.
Tokyo Tower.snack: Marion Crepes, Foot Town 1F, 09:00-22:30 - the halal-certified soft serve is the one named food actually trading when the coach arrives, and it does sweet and savoury crepes too. Plus the useful one nobody mentions: a full Lawson inside Foot Town 2F, 09:00-22:30, for water, coffee and onigiri for 35 people, and it takes cards and IC unlike tomorrow's market stalls. Our records carry no price for either, so budget rather than quote. Water matters: 600 m of unshaded pavement to Zojoji at 28°C.
Tokyo Tower.buy: TOKYO TOWER OFFICIAL SHOP THE SKY, Main Deck 2F, 09:00-22:30 - about ¥1,300 a head for the usual three: Tokyo Tower Caramel ¥280, the Nihon-Zanmai wooden magnet ¥600, tower-shaped bottled water ¥410, all of which survive a flight. Beside it, Tower Daijingu's deck-exclusive goshuin ¥300 and omamori ¥700, CASH AND COINS - a shrine desk is not a till, so do it at 09:05 while the deck is empty. If 35 people need more choice, GALAXY on Foot Town 3F is wider and also opens 09:00.
Tokyo Tower.see: Three things. The Skywalk Window glass panels set into the Main Deck 1F FLOOR, looking 145 m straight down - do it first, it jams the moment tour traffic arrives. Tower Daijingu on 2F, the highest shrine in the 23 wards. And the exterior group frame from Zojoji's Daiden courtyard 300 m away, shooting WNW on about 284° with the sun SE at 43° behind the photographer. FRAME THE DAIDEN, NOT THE GATE: the 1622 Sangedatsumon is inside a steel 素屋根 until about 2032. Promise Skytree, not Fuji.
correctedFromSeed: The group-rate question the seed leaves open is resolved: the agency page prints 一般団体（20名以上49名以下）大人 1,080円 with advance reservation required, while the public fee page's ¥1,350 is the walk-up group discount - and 「団体見学時におきましては、クレジットカードによるご精算を承っておりません」, so group settlement is cash only. Group desk 03-3433-5121.

Coach parking is free only if settled in ONE transaction at the Operation Center, and the operator warns 「駐車場が満車時等、留め置きができないときは、一度バスを回送いただく場合があります」 - the driver may be sent away and told to come back. The seed says only that parking is free.
Added the Foot Town 2F Lawson (09:00-22:30, cards and IC). The seed is right that the restaurants are shut but misses the one shop that solves water and a toilet stop for 35 people at 09:00.

The MAIN DECK photo service opens 10:00, so a paid deck portrait only works at 10:00 on the way out; the Top Deck photo service (09:00-22:15) and the Foot Town 3F counter (09:00-22:30) open with the building.

Zojoji additions the seed does not carry: the Tokugawa shogun cemetery viewing is currently SUSPENDED (徳川将軍家墓所 拝観休止のお知らせ on the temple's front page), and the Kuro-honzon is shown publicly on only three dates a year - 15 January, 15 May and 15 SEPTEMBER - so the group misses it by one day.

On a plain Monday the open-air staircase can only be walked DOWN: climbing up is 9:00-16:00 土日祝のみ, while coming down runs 9:00-20:00 daily - about 600 steps instead of the lift queue, cancelled in rain or wind.

Tsukiji Outer Market.do: Monday 14 September is a FULL trading day on the market's own calendar - the same Monday a week later (21 Sep, 敬老の日) would be shut. Start at Namiyoke Inari Shrine, the only open sky here and the only good light for faces, brief the group there, then work the 4-chome lanes back on foot. Sixty minutes and 35 people buys ONE queue and two counters. CASH IS THE TICKET: ¥3,000-5,000 a head in small notes, no bargaining, and NO currency exchange anywhere in the market - one Seven Bank ATM at ぷらっと築地.
Tsukiji Outer Market.eat: Tsukiji Yamacho, 6:00-15:30 with 定休日 なし - no closing day at all - for hot tamagoyaki on a skewer at roughly ¥150, the one thing guaranteed on sale whatever the calendar says. Kitsuneya (6:30-13:30) does the hormone-don eaten standing at a plank counter for ¥1,000-1,200 and the queue IS the cost: budget 22 minutes of the 60. Sushizanmai Honten is 24 hours, three floors, and the only place here that seats a group or takes cards. Lunch is a 12:15 crab miso set, so eat light.
Tsukiji Outer Market.snack: A stand-and-eat market with almost no seating, which makes this the best snack stop of the trip. Yamacho's 串玉 skewer at about ¥150, cash, hot, handed round 35 people in minutes - and it does not travel, so one skewer each. Tsukiji Sanokiya's tuna-shaped maguro-yaki is about ¥250 in hon-maguro, chu-toro and kihada, but HOURS CORRECTED to 8:00-15:00 「なくなり次第終了」 - it ends when it sells out, a real risk by 11:00 on a busy Monday, so treat it as a bonus.
Tsukiji Outer Market.buy: Sealed dry goods are the only things that fly. Maruyama Nori Honten (築地4-7-5, 7:00-18:00, closed Sundays and holidays) for 極めつけ『佐賀のはしり』, 有明こんとびブラック and 芽茶80; Ito Noriten (address corrected to 築地4-14-14, 8:00-14:00, founded 1923) for yaki-nori, ajitsuke-nori, furikake and dashi packs. NOT Uogashi Meicha, which closes Sundays AND Mondays. Knives: Aritsugu 6:00-15:00 (about ¥25,000) or Tojiro Knife Gallery 8:00-15:00 (about ¥8,000) - CHECKED baggage only.
Tsukiji Outer Market.see: The low blue-and-green tarpaulin lane roofs with the tower cranes of the Tsukiji redevelopment rising directly behind them - the best single frame of old and new Tokyo in the neighbourhood. Stand IN an east-west lane about two-thirds of the way down and crouch slightly. The turret trucks are the market's signature moving image and they run these lanes at speed and stop for nobody: put someone on lookout. Closed toes, no heels or sandals - the market prints that rule itself.
correctedFromSeed: Tsukiji Sanokiya opens 8:00, not the seed's 07:00, and the market's own directory adds 「なくなり次第終了」 - it closes when it sells out, which for a 10:50 arrival is the part that matters (day7-tokyo 5218cebcf469).
The Kengo Kuma-designed Jugetsudo is the GINZA Kabukiza branch, not this one - the Tsukiji shop at 築地4-7-5 makes no such claim on its own listing. The seed attaches the Kuma building to Tsukiji.
Ito Noriten is at 築地4-14-14, not the 4-13-18 our inventory carried (a different building), and it shuts at 14:00, two hours after the coach leaves.
Tsukiji Aritsugu opens 6:00, not 05:30 (the market's own directory), and closes only on market closing days - the most reliably open of the knife shops on a Monday.

Turret Coffee's address 築地2-12-6 is right but it geocodes about 330 m NORTH of the seed's pin, OUTSIDE the 4-chome lanes and 5-6 minutes each way up towards Tsukiji Station - 12 minutes of a 60-minute stop. Shoot a working turret in the lanes instead (notes7.md).

Added the cash reality the seed omits: most shops are yen-cash only, card acceptance varies, 「No negotiation can be accepted」, there is no currency exchange counter anywhere in the market, and the only ATM is the Seven Bank machine at the ぷらっと築地 information centre.

Shisui Premium Outlets.do: Collect the floor map at the Information Center - the operator puts it 「フードコート前」, in front of the food court, with the lockers (¥400-1,000) in the lounge behind it - and make that the single hard regroup. Split the 2.5 hours into two halves and set the deadline at 16:45, not 17:00: tax-free is granted at each shop's own till, so the queue is INSIDE the shops and it lands at the end when everyone decides at once. 2120区 Ecco is the far end - anyone out there at 16:30 will not clear a till.
Shisui Premium Outlets.eat: Nothing here shuts before the coach, which makes Shisui the one Day 7 stop with no hours conflict at all: shops and food court 10:00-20:00, cafés 9:30-20:00, restaurants 11:00-21:00. Dinner is 18:00 at the hotel, so this is the coffee-and-sit stop, not a meal. If anyone does eat, Soryu Togyokudo at 1330区 is 92 seats and the only room that swallows a coach party - and it is pork-heavy tantanmen, so check first. Kawatoyo's unagi branch at 1600区 closes the loop the Naritasan honten leaves open.
Shisui Premium Outlets.snack: Gong cha at 1440区 and the Delifrance bakery café at 1325区, both 9:30-20:00, are the quick-and-cheap answer against 2.5 hours of unshaded walking at 28°C; Botejyu Yatai does Osaka okonomiyaki and yakisoba inside the food court. The seasonal one is boiled oomasari peanuts, about ¥800 a bag and genuinely in season August to October - but they are sold wet and refrigerated, so eat them here or on the coach. Water and a Seven Bank ATM at the Seven-Eleven, 1845区, 9:30-20:00.
Shisui Premium Outlets.buy: Tax-free is deducted AT THE TILL - ¥5,000 excluding tax PER STORE PER DAY, passport to the cashier - because Japan does not move to airport refunds until 1 Nov 2026, and there is NO central desk here at all. So spend DEEP in few shops: ¥15,000 in Coach or Polo Ralph Lauren clears it in one receipt. For things you cannot buy in Penang, target the Japanese labels - United Arrows is confirmed at 1500区, with Onitsuka Tiger and Beams around it. Keep every receipt separate.
Shisui Premium Outlets.see: A flat, single-level, open-air American-village strip across about 421,000 m², so from the plaza in front of the food court you can see the whole thing end to end - which is why it works as a split-and-regroup coach stop, with 約5,000台（無料） of free parking and the coach doubling as bag store, shade and toilet base. Shoot ALONG the strip, not across it, and put faces in an awning's shade against the flat 14:30 glare. Narita is about 14 km east, so approach traffic crosses overhead all afternoon.
correctedFromSeed: The seed's 'look for boiled and roasted rakkasei' is half wrong. Boiled oomasari IS in season (roughly August to October, about ¥800 a bag) but is sold wet and refrigerated and cannot fly; the ROASTED new crop is not out until mid-October. If peanuts have to travel home, it is peanut monaka, not either of these.
The working deadline is 16:45, not the 17:00 departure, because tax-free paperwork happens at each shop's own till - the queue is inside the shops and lands all at once (day7-tokyo subRoute d7sub3).

Added the facilities the seed omits: lockers at ¥400-1,000 in the lounge behind the Information Center (¥600-1,000 at 450区 and 1500区), ATMs at 1140区 9:30-21:00, and the Seven-Eleven at 1845区 9:30-20:00 with the parcel desk.

The seed's 'about 20 minutes from Narita' is right but the leg that matters is Shisui to tonight's hotel, which is 14 km - so this is the last chance for water before a short run east, not a long one.

The site coordinate for the Information Center, the coach park and the central-plaza must-see was corrected by 2.4 km - the old pin sat on the 酒々井町 town centroid, and five independent sources put the mall at 35.714 / 140.294 (topup-misc.json).
Named the rooms that can actually take 35 (Soryu Togyokudo, 1330区, 92 seats, L.O. 20:30) and the in-mall Kawatoyo unagi branch at 1600区, 11:00-21:00 - the seed's food line is generic.

International Resort Hotel Yurakujo.do: Tokyo Yurakujo, the attached bath complex three minutes away, IS the evening - and Monday hours apply: 「月曜日17:00~22:00（祝日除く）」 with 最終受付 21:00, against the 13:00 opening of every other day, so a 17:30 check-in lands right on it. THE VOUCHER CATCH: guests are said to get free entry worth ¥1,800, but the weekday adult rate drops to 「18時以後1,000円」 - and dinner is 18:00, so the only window in which the voucher is worth its stated ¥1,800 is 17:30-18:00. Check-in 15:00, check-out 11:00, 490 rooms.
International Resort Hotel Yurakujo.eat: The 18:00 dinner is most likely トミサト酒場 inside the bath building - the operator says it is currently 団体のみ, group bookings only, Monday 17:00-21:30 with L.O. 21:00, ordering off Tomisatoya's menu - which is exactly what a 35-person party at 18:00 is for; if the agent has not booked it, the fallback is the California Restaurant buffet on 1F. Mitsuan-seki, the private room the operator lists for 8 to 50 guests, is the one space that seats 35 without splitting them. Breakfast 6:30-10:30.
International Resort Hotel Yurakujo.snack: The 7-Eleven is INSIDE the main building on the lobby floor - the operator's own facility page says so, which kills the 'about 80 m from the door' line - with Chiba souvenirs and an ATM, and about ¥1,500 covers a box plus water for a 10:55 flight. Its hours are published nowhere: confirm at check-in, do not assume 24 hours. The other quick food is the 甘味処 dessert counter beside Tomisatoya, Monday 17:00-21:30. Nothing else is walkable: the next konbini is 1.4 km on unlit road with no footpath.
International Resort Hotel Yurakujo.buy: The lobby 7-Eleven, and for a group flying at 10:55 tomorrow it is the most useful retail on the property. The proper local buy - Nagomi no Yoneya's peanut monaka on the Naritasan approach, about ¥700 a box, peanut paste in a peanut-shaped wafer, boxed and shelf-stable so it survives the flight - is UNREACHABLE on this itinerary: the approach shops shut about 17:00, check-in is 17:30, and Day 8 leaves after a 06:30 breakfast. Ask the agent for a Naritasan stop. Boiled peanuts do not fly.
International Resort Hotel Yurakujo.see: Aircraft, not scenery. The hotel sits 4.4 km from Narita Terminal 1 under the approach corridor, and the named frame is Narita Sakura-no-Yama, about 4 km out at 成田市駒井野1338 - a grassed hill at the northern threshold of Runway A where landing aircraft pass low overhead, free, 06:00-23:00, and the reason it belongs in a coach itinerary is THREE FREE LARGE-BUS BAYS. It needs the coach, not legs: 4 km of unlit rural road. Sunrise on the 15th is about 05:25 and the curfew lifts about 06:00.
correctedFromSeed: The ¥1,800 guest bathing voucher is only worth ¥1,800 if used BEFORE 18:00, because the walk-in weekday rate drops to 「18時以後1,000円」 - and dinner is at 18:00, so the window is 17:30-18:00, i.e. check-in itself. The seed states the ¥1,800 value without the catch.

IT IS NOT AN ONSEN. The operator's own bath list is 露天風呂, 森の湯 (jojoba oil), 白湯 (plain hot water), 還元マグマの湯 (Himalayan salt), 低温風呂 34-38°C, sauna and stone-bed sauna, with 「総檜の水風呂は天然地下水を使用」 for the cold plunge only - no spring analysis and no 泉質 anywhere, despite the 湯 in the name and the site's own 「大型温泉スパ施設」 headline.

The seed makes tonight's dinner the California Restaurant's Hawaiian buffet. The itinerary's 18:00 meal is an izakaya dinner and the likeliest venue is トミサト酒場 (団体のみ) inside the bath building; the 140-seat count and the 1 Jul-30 Sep Hawaiian buffet are inventory claims the hotel does not publish. California Restaurant IS confirmed for breakfast, 6:30-10:30 at ¥1,700-2,900 walk-in.

The 7-Eleven is inside the main building at lobby level on the operator's own facility page (the access page omits it entirely), and its hours are unpublished - so 'there is a 7-Eleven inside the hotel lobby' is right but must not be sold as 24 hours.
Nagomi no Yoneya's peanut monaka - the seed's 'proper local buy' - is unreachable on this itinerary at either end of the night, so it is an agent request, not a group activity.
The free shuttle cannot move the group: 「バスは座席定員制です。立席は法律上お受けできかねません」 - seats only, so 35 people cannot leave together for Aeon Mall or Keisei Narita.

Narita Airport — Terminal 1 South Wing.do: TERMINAL CONFIRMED, not inferred: Narita's own airline page prints Singapore Airlines as 「T1 South Wing / 4F」. SQ's own table opens counters three hours before departure (07:55) and CLOSES them 40 minutes before (10:15) - that, not boarding, is the day's real deadline. The coach is in about 07:20, so the dead half hour goes to the free ITOKI work and open lounges on South Wing 4F, 108 seats, 05:00-24:00. Bags first, then the 5F deck; security queue by 09:45.
Narita Airport — Terminal 1 South Wing.eat: CORRECTION to the seed: it is not true that nothing trades before 07:30. McDonald's on T1 Central Building 4F landside runs 06:30-21:30 (L.O.); Tully's and SUBWAY on South Wing 4F both open 07:00. LAWSON on B1F is 24 hours, which matters because Narita states only 1F and B1F are open round the clock while the upper floors run 05:00-24:00. The 5F SKY FOOD COURT sits inside SHIKISAI GARDEN and the 5F area opens 05:00, but its tenants publish no hours. Ippudo is 3F AIRSIDE, 07:30-20:30 L.O.
Narita Airport — Terminal 1 South Wing.snack: SUBWAY on South Wing 4F, 07:00-21:00, is the one to name: a made-to-order sub is the only thing here you can legitimately carry through security and eat on your own schedule rather than the cabin's - buy the drink airside, because nothing over 100 ml crosses. Otherwise LAWSON B1F, 24 hours, which is also a designated zipper-transparent-bag store for the 1-litre clear liquids bag, about ¥150. Capsule Marche on 5F, 05:00-23:00, is where leftover ¥100 and ¥500 coins go: notes change, coins do not.
Narita Airport — Terminal 1 South Wing.buy: THE RUN IS AIRSIDE. Narita Nakamise is South Wing 3F AFTER security, roughly 07:30-22:00, so plan 09:50-10:25 with a get-back-by of 10:25. At Fa-So-La TAX FREE AKIHABARA: Shiroi Koibito ¥1,320 for 18 and ¥1,760 for 24, Tokyo Banana ¥691 / ¥1,296 / ¥1,944 for 4 / 8 / 12 and NOT marked up here, the Narita-only maneki-neko box ¥1,400 for 24, ROYCE' nama chocolate ¥1,215 for 20 - buy the refrigerated item LAST. Landside, TOKYO SHOKUHIN KAN 4F opens 07:30 and Fa-So-La GIFT SHOP 4F at 07:00.
Narita Airport — Terminal 1 South Wing.see: The 5F GARDEN WALK observation deck, rebuilt and reopened 9 April 2026 - free, open from 06:30, and the only place in the building where 35 people can spread out for a last group shot. The old mesh fence is gone: wire at about 7 cm spacing that a phone lens goes through, and a raised 2.5 m timber Mountain Deck to see over it. Three hot-water footbaths at the north end, each about 5 m by 0.8 m, free - bring a towel from the room. The SHIKISAI GARDEN lounges do not open until about 13:30.
correctedFromSeed: Narita Nakamise is South Wing 3F AIRSIDE, roughly 07:30-22:00 - not the 4F landside street the seed describes - so the seed's headline instruction, 'do the souvenir run BEFORE security, not after', is backwards. The omiyage run moves to 09:50-10:25, after immigration.

Counters open 07:55 and close 10:15 on Singapore Airlines' own Narita table, not the seed's 'roughly 08:00-08:25'. 10:15 is the hard deadline, and any liquid over 100 ml must be in the checked bag before it.

Plenty trades before 07:30: LAWSON B1F 24 h, the GARDEN WALK deck from 06:30, McDonald's 4F Central from 06:30, Tully's / SUBWAY / Fa-So-La GIFT SHOP / DRUG BOX from 07:00, YAMADA TAX FREE from 07:30, and the free 108-seat ITOKI lounges from 05:00 - not just the 5F gachapon shop and the vending machines.

The 5F deck is a 2026 rebuild (reopened 9 Apr 2026) with a Mountain Deck and three free footbaths; the seed's 'free observation deck looking straight down Runway A' understates it. And the free 130-seat SHIKISAI GARDEN relaxation rooms are SHUT until about 13:30, so they cannot be part of the wait.

ROYCE' nama chocolate is ¥1,215 for 20 pieces and prints 要冷蔵, 10°C or below: Narita 10:55 to Penang 20:35 is eleven hours door to door and an ice pack will not hold that, so it arrives soft. The seed's 'with the ice pack, in hand baggage' is right about the method and wrong about the outcome - buy the bar or potato-chip chocolate for pristine.

Malaysian limits, beyond the seed's 1 litre of liquor: cigarettes and tobacco are EXCLUDED from the traveller exemption altogether, and there is an RM1,000 (about ¥30,000) ceiling on other goods per adult arriving by air.
The seed's 'gates via Satellite 3' could not be verified from any official page and departure gates are not assignable in advance, so it is not repeated (notes8.md §1).

Ooedo Onsen Monogatari Naruko Onsen Koun.do: Night 2, Wed 9 Sep: arrive 18:30 with dinner at 19:00, and published check-in is 15:00-19:00, so this is the most comfortable arrival of the three new hotels. Do BOTH waters, because Naruko holds nine of Japan's eleven spring types and this one property gives you two: the dark 黒湯 in the main building's 6F bath with its own rotenburo, and the milky 白湯 in the annexe 1F. Both 15:00-24:00 and again 05:00-10:00. Day visitors are confined to the 6F, so take the annexe tonight and the 6F at 05:30.
Ooedo Onsen Monogatari Naruko Onsen Koun.eat: FORMAT CONFLICT the agent has to settle: the itinerary says 19:00 Kaiseki, but Ooedo's own product here is a グルメバイキング buffet on 2F against a 17:00-21:30 service window, whose selling line is 「地元産生まぐろが食べ放題」 - while JTB's meal field for this property does print 和食会席 for dinner and バイキング（和食） for breakfast. Both are real products here. And NO CHANNEL PUBLISHES THE BREAKFAST TIME, so the 07:30 sitting against an 08:30 coach is the one hours check on Night 2 that cannot be verified - ask at check-in.
Ooedo Onsen Monogatari Naruko Onsen Koun.snack: Lawson Osaki Naruko Onsen is 78 m from the door and 24 hours is CONFIRMED on Miyagi's own shop registry - 鳴子温泉車湯92-45, the same aza and postcode as the hotel, 営業時間「24時間営業」 / 定休日「なし」. That is the answer at 22:00 and 06:00 alike, and it is where you buy a face towel and body soap, about ¥600 the pair, because Taki-no-Yu sells neither. In town, Mochidokoro Fukase's kuri-dango is ¥400 for two but opens 09:00 - after the coach has gone.
Ooedo Onsen Monogatari Naruko Onsen Koun.buy: The lobby shop, 15:00-20:30 - open across the whole arrival-and-dinner evening and SHUT before the 08:30 coach, so buy tonight. Naruko kokeshi is the buy: the strain whose head squeaks when you turn it, because head and body are turned separately on the lathe. Mini pieces about ¥2,640, a small ejiko about ¥3,300. Solid wood, no shelf life - but wrap it. Two cash charges at the desk: Miyagi accommodation tax ¥300 a night plus bathing tax.
Ooedo Onsen Monogatari Naruko Onsen Koun.see: There is no daylight frame: you land at 18:30, after the 17:54 sunset, in a gorge town with no useful street lighting. So the group shot is the flat free car park in front of the lit entrance - stand 15 to 20 m back with the group facing the building, the name board behind them and the coach's flank filling the left third. The same position works for the 08:30 departure. The real Naruko frame is 05:45-06:30, two-thirds up the shrine stairway over steaming tin roofs.

Mercure Miyagi Zao Resort & Spa.do: Arrive 17:15 with dinner at 18:00, so the sequence that works is bath, buffet, lounge. Fudo-no-Yu is the named open-air bath on Togatta Onsen water, a hinoki tub run かけ流し with a stone tub beside it, plus two indoor 大浴場 and a free sauna - all 15:00-23:00 (last entry 22:30) and again 06:00-10:00 (last entry 09:30). TAKE YOUR OWN TOWEL: the hotel's FAQ answers the question 「お部屋からお持ちください」. Tattoos need two 8 x 10 cm cover stickers, ¥200 at the desk. A 45-seat coach is fine: 270 free spaces.
Mercure Miyagi Zao Resort & Spa.eat: THE ITINERARY CALLS IT KAISEKI AND IT IS A BUFFET: Locavore on 2F, 268 seats, dinner 「17:30〜21:00（最終入場20:30）」, so an 18:00 sitting is well inside - gyutan carved to order, zunda mochi, dashi with sasa-kamaboko, atsuage tofu, ¥8,000 a head bought separately. Yukata and slippers are expressly allowed: 「浴衣・スリッパでご利用いただけます」. No sittings are published and one guest counted 800 diners against 268 seats, so 35 people arriving unbooked at 18:00 is a real risk - ring 0224-34-3600.
Mercure Miyagi Zao Resort & Spa.snack: No street food and no bath town: this is a 312-room resort standing alone on the Zao plateau, and the hotel's own FAQ puts the nearest Seven-Eleven at 「車で約5分（徒歩約20分）」 on an unlit road. So the honest answer is in-house: the 1F shop 16:30-21:00, and the 20:00-22:00 鳥渡 Night Cap lounge session, where reviewers single out Zao cheese with crackers as the free snack. Water servers on floors 5 to 11 run round the clock for the 08:00 coach. Buy water and an umbrella before you leave Zao Fox Village.
Mercure Miyagi Zao Resort & Spa.buy: The 1F shop, 16:30-21:00 tonight - and buy tonight, because its morning window opens at 08:00, exactly when the coach leaves. A JTB reviewer calls it 「一階の土産物屋が広くて明るくて品揃えも豊富」. Best buys: a Togatta kokeshi, a genuinely different strain from Naruko's - a broad painted chrysanthemum on the crown and a slim body - about ¥3,000, turned wood so it flies; and ambient vacuum-packed Sendai gyutan, about ¥1,800. Zao cream cheese at about ¥648 is chilled and does NOT fly.
Mercure Miyagi Zao Resort & Spa.see: The courtyard lawn, and what the prefecture move bought: real dark sky. Sunset on 10 Sep is about 17:50, so a 17:15 arrival leaves roughly thirty minutes of dusk - use them before dinner, not after. Walk into the middle of the 「芝生が生い茂る中庭」, put the lit facade BEHIND the group and shoot away from it. For mountains, stand at the far end of the front car park at 06:00 facing WSW: the Zao massif catches first light while you are still in shade. Then breakfast at 07:00 sharp.

Kinugawa Onsen Hana no Yado Matsuya.do: You enter at the TOP: the hotel is built down the slope, so the front desk and the 花かんざし lounge are both on the 5TH FLOOR. Two things must be settled at check-in - which kaiseki sitting the group is on, and a room for the Mission 2 yukata photograph. THE YUKATA ARE IN THE ROOM (大人浴衣 on the amenity list), so the old front-desk queue is gone; a 45-set colour rental is ¥3,300 if matching is wanted. Warn the driver: the free lot (18 spaces, 8 for large buses) is down a steep drop off Route 121.
Kinugawa Onsen Hana no Yado Matsuya.eat: NOT A BUFFET, whatever the itinerary prints: dinner is 和食会席 plated to the table in private rooms on 4F, and the start is CHOSEN, not assigned - 「午後6時からまたは午後6時30分から、午後7時から」, last seating 19:00. TAKE THE 19:00: ten minutes from an 18:20 arrival into yukata for 35 people plus a group photograph is not achievable, and a kaiseki that has started cannot be drifted into. Breakfast is a 和食膳, also chosen from 07:00 / 07:30 / 08:00, against an 08:30 coach.
Kinugawa Onsen Hana no Yado Matsuya.snack: Genuinely nothing standing-up here, and that is the honest answer. The 5F drink corner runs 14:00-17:00 and is already shut at an 18:20 arrival, and the nearest konbini - Lawson Kinugawa-Taki, 24 hours confirmed on Nikko City's own AED register - is 1.24 km straight line, about 1.5 km and 20 minutes on the road. There is no konbini within 500 m of the door. In-house the only buy is the 5F shop 花ごよみ to 21:00, plus a frozen-food corner by the lounge that nothing can be taken home from.
Kinugawa Onsen Hana no Yado Matsuya.buy: 花ごよみ on the 5F lobby floor, 07:00-10:00 and 15:30-21:00 - the ONLY one of the three new hotels' shops that opens before the coach. The distinctive buy of the whole trip is here: the hotel is themed on Taisho illustrator Takehisa Yumeji and a stay report says the shop is full of Yumeji merchandise, 「竹久夢二の作品にまつわるお土産品が多く置かれてました」 - flat printed goods that pack perfectly, about ¥1,200. Then DRIED Nikko yuba at about ¥800, light and ambient unlike the fresh sheets.
Kinugawa Onsen Hana no Yado Matsuya.see: Two frames. Indoors, the 5F 花かんざし lounge: Takehisa Yumeji paintings, a 夢二人形 dolls cabinet and a glass wall onto the Kinugawa gorge - stand the group ALONG that glass facing INTO the room, because at 18:30 in September the window is dead black and will silhouette all 35. Outdoors, Takimi Bridge over the derelict cliff-side hotels, now about 290 m and five minutes from the door instead of seventeen: sunrise 12 Sep is about 05:20, so 05:45-06:30 has it empty. No autumn colour until late October.

Ginza.do: Day 7 BACKUP for Shisui, and the whole stop hangs on where a 45-seat coach stops. Chuo-ku's designated bay is 銀座六丁目 on Mihara-dori beside GINZA SIX: 3 bays, 10:00-21:00, 無料（事前登録予約制） through Times, and 「利用時間を1回あたり15分とします」 - DROP-OFF ONLY, so book TWO slots (13:45 down, about 16:30 up) and the coach waits at Times Harumi 4-chome, ¥2,000/hour, roughly ¥6,000 and 12 minutes each way. Regroup 16:15 on the kerb, not inside a building.
Ginza.eat: Lunch is a 12:15 crab miso set, so this is a quick-eat stop. Ginza Kimuraya at the 4-chome crossing (銀座4-5-7, 10:00-20:00, 無休) invented anpan: buy the sakadane anpan over the 1F counter for a few hundred yen and eat it walking. To sit, Beer Hall Lion 7-chome is four minutes from the bay - 1934, 280 seats, a barrel-vaulted glass-mosaic room and the one interior in Ginza worth sitting in - but 「ご予約は承っておりません」, so 35 people cannot be guaranteed a table.
Ginza.snack: The anpan is the snack: over the counter at Kimuraya a few doors from the clock tower, a few hundred yen, cash quickest at a counter that busy, eaten at the crossing - and it has a one-to-two day life, so it is walk-and-eat and has no business in a suitcase. If anyone wants more, the Kabukiza Kobikicho Hiroba basement (中央区銀座4-12-15 地下2階, 「9:30〜18:30」, free, no ticket) has food stalls and a convenience store, seven minutes east along Harumi-dori.
Ginza.buy: Two things Shisui cannot do. UNIQLO Ginza - twelve floors, about 5,000 m², the largest in the world, three minutes from the bay and 免税対応店 - is one shop, one till and therefore ONE tax-free receipt: ¥8,000 clears the ¥5,000 threshold in a single go. And LOTTE DUTY FREE 9F in GinzaNovo (11:00-21:00): pay in Ginza, collect after immigration at Narita tomorrow, 「出国の60日前から1日前まで」. Best gift-per-gram: Natsuno engraved chopsticks ¥1,500-3,000, Kyukyodo incense from a few hundred yen (closes 19:00).
Ginza.see: The Wako clock tower - Jin Watanabe, 1932, signed SEIKO HOUSE GINZA since June 2022. Stand on the SOUTH-EAST corner outside GINZA PLACE (銀座5-8-1, Ginza Station exit A4) and shoot back NORTH-WEST; at 14:30-15:30 the sun is 80-100° to your left: faces side-lit, no flare. Do NOT shoot from the Mitsukoshi corner, which faces into it, and keep the fourth corner out of frame: San-ai is hoarding until 2027. Monday means the Chuo-dori precinct is OFF: cross at the 4-chome and 6-chome signals only.
